# LiQi Toys

> A custom toy and promotional products manufacturer in Quanzhou, China. OEM and ODM services for plastic toys, figures, PVC products and promotional gifts, backed by two specialized factories and 15+ years of experience.

## Company facts

- Legal name: QuanZhou LiQi Plastic Products Co., Ltd. (also: Jinjiang LiQi Mould Co., Ltd.)
- Website: https://liqi-global-website.zhaolync.workers.dev/
- Founded / experience: 15+ years
- Factories: 2 (one plastic products factory, one mold factory)
- Location: Anping Industrial Area, Anhai Town, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian, China
- Services: OEM, ODM, custom design, mold development, injection molding, printing, assembly, packaging
- Email: zhaolyn@qzluckyseven.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 18100544537
- Social: Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube, LinkedIn (links available on the website)

## Products

- Custom plastic figures and figure toys
- PVC products
- Plastic toys
- Promotional gifts and souvenirs

## Production process

Inquiry and quotation → sample development → mold making → injection molding → printing and assembly → quality inspection → final packaging.

## Frequently asked questions

- What can LiQi make? Custom plastic toys, figures, PVC products, candy toys, promotional bags, gifts and stationery, made to order.
- Do you support OEM/ODM? Yes, from your design and artwork to product development, mold making, production and packaging.
- Do you make molds in-house? Yes, through Jinjiang LiQi Mould Co., Ltd.
- Where is the factory? Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian, China. Factory visits are welcome.
- How to get a quote? Send your product idea, drawings or sample with quantity and packaging requirements by email, phone or WhatsApp.
